sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233920, fetched 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233920 ('the only one with full hookups for RVs') + RIDB catalog (all 94 public RV ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Yes, Sewer Hookup Y/Yes), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 106 standard electric (full-hookup) sites and 54 tent-only primitive sites per the Forest Service; recreation.gov sells 94 RV sites (the rest are management/host sites) and 52 tent sites. Every RV site is a 40-ft back-in. Only one vehicle may park on the site spur unless both fit on the pad; two vehicles are included in the fee (a boat counts as one) and nothing may park on the grass. No cell coverage or internet.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/salt-springs-recreation-area ('Standard electric campsites: 106 sites in the campground', 'Tent-only primitive campsites: 54 sites') + RIDB catalog (94 RV ELECTRIC, 52 TENT ONLY, 14 MANAGEMENT; Max Vehicle Length 40, Driveway Entry Back-in) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233920 (notices on vehicles, parking and 'There is no cell phone coverage or internet service at Salt Springs'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Unimproved boat launch at the end of the campground on Salt Springs Run; the Salt Springs community has a grocery store, gas station and laundromat.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233920 (amenities: Showers, Flush Toilets, Drinking Water, Dump Station; 'There is no cell phone coverage or internet service at Salt Springs'; Facilities: 'community of Salt Springs, which has a gas station, grocery store ... laundromat') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/salt-springs-recreation-area ('An unimproved boat launch is located at the end of the campground closest to Salt Springs Run'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14 nights in any 30-day period. Reservations on Recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777; run by the concessioner Naventure. The site you reserve is your site (no moving).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233920 (facility_rules maxStay 14, 'Rolling 30 Days'; notices 'Stays are only allowed for 14 days in any 30 day period', 'You may not move to another site') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/salt-springs-recreation-area ('Reservations for the campground may be made by phone at 1-877-444-6777 or online at Recreation.gov', 'This site is operated by Naventure'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026 rate table: standard electric (full hookup) $70 a night, tent-only $38.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233920/rates (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 Peak: STANDARD ELECTRIC 70, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 38; same for 2027), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on recreation.gov, the RIDB catalog and the Ocala NF page: $70 full-hookup sites (2026 and 2027 tables), 50-amp/water/sewer, 106 electric + 54 tent sites (94 + 52 sold online), all RV sites 40-ft back-ins, showers/flush toilets/water/dump, no internet, reservable on rec.gov with a 14-in-30 maximum. rec.gov's weekend minimum is 0 (no rule). Not stated: season, booking window, fcfs. Note unchanged.
flags: Phone: entry has the recreation.gov line 877-444-6777; the facility phone on recreation.gov is 352-685-2048 (operator Naventure, contact@naventure.com).
Concession-run: the Forest Service page says 'This site is operated by Naventure'; it is a USFS facility booked on recreation.gov, so ownership federal looks right.
